title: The charger needs an app—via QR
scenario: At a station, the only visible EV/phone charging instructions are a QR sticker saying “new app required.” The page opens an app-store-looking screen and asks for card details before download.

answers.A: Use another charger if you cannot confirm the operator and official payment method.
answers.B: Continue if the page shows the right charger number and location, because that data would be hard to fake.
answers.C: Find the operator name on the charger and get its app from the official app store listing or operator website you locate independently.

explanation: Attackers can place QR stickers on real infrastructure and copy location details. The physical object is real; the QR destination may not be.
proTip: Real machine, fake sticker is a powerful combination.
